theme.description: High-contrast tactical dark theme for intense focus during online examinations and modern SaaS dashboard; crisp academic light theme for study material, reading & course discovery.

dark_portal.palette_archetype: ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Tactical Exam Focus & High-Precision Analytics)

responsive.layout: Multi-column grids condense to single column on mobile (< 768px). Online Exam Interface shifts to tabbed bottom sheet / slide-over panel for Question Palette on mobile viewports. Dashboard stats convert to horizontal scroll / 2x2 grid.
responsive.typography: Mobile responsive fluid sizing with rem units. Inputs stay minimum 16px to prevent iOS auto-zoom.
responsive.overflow_guard: Ensure max-w-full and overflow-x-hidden on root containers to prevent unintended horizontal scrollbars.
responsive.tap_targets: Minimum 48px by 48px tap areas for exam action buttons (Next, Mark for Review, Clear Response, Question Palette Nodes).

surface_strategies.marketing_hero: Dark slate grid mesh background with subtle ambient radial glow, clear overlay, semi-transparent sticky glass header (backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/80 border-b border-slate-800)
surface_strategies.exam_portal: Full screen strict distraction-free layout (h-screen overflow-hidden). Dark solid crisp panels, high contrast timer bar, status-coded question palette grid.
surface_strategies.lms_course_player: Split view layout (70% video player / reading pane, 30% section lesson tree drawer). Mobile view turns lesson tree into tabbed modal drawer.
surface_strategies.admin_dashboard: High-density data grid (MODE B), cardless or subtle border container layout, sharp radii (rounded-md), status pills, search & multi-select filters.

grids.marketing: MODE A: TETRIS GRID (col-span-12 with generous gap-8)
grids.dashboard: MODE B: HIGH DENSITY GRID (col-span-4 / col-span-12 with gap-4 to gap-6)
grids.exam_palette: grid-cols-5 sm:grid-cols-6 md:grid-cols-5 gap-2 font-mono text-sm

motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out, transition-transform duration-150 ease-out
motion.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion, avoid jarring layout shifts, micro-hover scales limited to 1.02x

testing.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based (e.g., test-card-item, exam-start-btn, question-option-radio, mark-for-review-btn, submit-exam-btn, timer-display, analytics-chart-card)

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-grade, highly intuitive hybrid platform: Public Marketing Portal + Student LMS Dashboard + Online Examination Engine + Question Bank Admin + LMS Course Hierarchy.

Implement the Online Examination Engine with full real-time features: live countdown timer with amber/red warnings, question status palette grid (Answered, Not Answered, Marked for Review, Answered & Marked, Not Visited), section switcher (Quant, Reasoning, English, GA), autosave state, question bookmarking, calculator toggle modal, and submission summary popup.

Provide a detailed Exam Performance Result & Solution Review screen featuring score breakdown, accuracy percentage, time spent per question, topic-wise analysis, and step-by-step solutions with KaTeX math rendering.
Ensure LMS Course Hierarchy (Course -> Sections -> Lessons -> Video/PDF Resources) has a modern player experience with progress tracking, notes, and downloadable attachments.

Ensure Admin Panel includes complete multi-group management (Question Bank Builder, Test Builder with negative marking setup, User Management, Order History, Razorpay Payment Gateway integration status, Analytics).
Include sample exam packages for Indian competitive exams (SSC CGL, UPSC Civil Services, Banking SBI/IBPS PO, Railways RRB NTPC, NEET/JEE Mock Tests).
Make all key elements testable with explicit data-testid attributes.
Provide Theme Toggle between Dark Portal Mode (Exam center vibe) and Light Academic Mode.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic AI slop look - build layered, tactile, high-precision visual hierarchies.
DO NOT use raw transparent header backgrounds; use glassmorphism with blur or solid background.
DO NOT use universal transition 'transition: all'. Explicitly state transition properties.
Ensure mobile responsiveness: single column stack on smaller screens, touch-friendly target sizes (min 48px).
Always add data-testid to interactive and key data display elements.
